provenance.note: Ground-height bands over the box 82.95-83.55 E, 17.50-18.00 N. FABDEM stores this sea as exact 0 m, so those pixels are removed as sea; there is no city-boundary clip (we have not found published GVMC boundary geometry), so the bands also cover land just outside GVMC. Band edges follow the FABDEM land percentiles (p1=3 p5=7 p20=21 p50=48 p80=88 p95=186 p100=587 m). Bands, not spot heights. CC BY-NC-SA encumbered via FABDEM.

name: elevation-bands-visakhapatnam
_provenance: FABDEM V1-2 (Hawker et al., University of Bristol; satellite-derived 30 m DEM with buildings and forests removed) via Google Earth Engine, classified into ground-height bands. The sea (FABDEM's exact 0 m) is removed; there is no city-boundary clip, as we have not found published GVMC boundary geometry. Read them as bands, not spot heights.
